::: {.note .veto}
**The plus or minus is ONE standard error**, the spread across iterations
divided by the square root of 10000. It covers about 68 percent,
not 95.

The figure above is against boss armor 6193. This same set was run
against every Phase 3 armor tier, and armor is subtracted before any physical
damage lands, so a physical spec moves between them and a pure caster does not.

## Where this set differs from the published page

The Phase 3 list was captured from Wowhead and is never edited. A published list
ranks a weapon for one spec in isolation, and a raid has one of each, so the
guild lead routed the contested weapons on 15 August 2026. Those rulings are
applied when this profile is built, which is why the capture and the set below
disagree in these slots and only these.

- main_hand: Zhar'doom, Greatstaff of the Devourer replaces Tempest of Chaos. Routed by the guild lead, 15 August 2026: Zhar'doom goes to the warlocks, the Balance Druid, the Elemental Shaman and the Shadow Priest.
- off_hand: EMPTY replaces Chronicle of Dark Secrets. Zhar'doom is a two-handed staff and the guild lead ruled that its users hold no off hand. The captured off hand is discarded, not carried.
